body:
# Stock Vein

**Stock Vein** is a fictional Minecraft economy plugin where players build mining rigs, unlock new technology, buy physical computer parts, rent servers, trade fake Bitcoin, and progress through a company-driven tech release system.

Stock Vein is designed to feel like a full server economy system, not just a simple shop plugin. Players do not just click one button to upgrade forever. Instead, they buy real in-game items, install them into mining rigs, manage their setup, and slowly unlock better technology over time.

> **Important:** All Bitcoin, mining, hacking, companies, black market, and technology systems in Stock Vein are fictional Minecraft gameplay mechanics only. This plugin does not use real cryptocurrency, real mining, real hacking tools, real accounts, or real money.

---
(this is for version 1.0.2 only)
## Main Features

- Fake Bitcoin mining system
- Physical mining rig parts
- Clean categorized shop GUI
- Company technology release system
- 250+ progression tech items
- Slow tech drip progression
- Rented server contracts
- Fake black market / unknown vendor events
- Fake high-risk hacking minigame mechanics
- Player mining setup dashboard
- Admin audit tools
- Safer economy transaction handling
- Vault / VaultUnlocked economy support

---

## Physical Mining System

Stock Vein uses a physical item-based mining system.

Instead of simple one-click upgrades like “RAM Level 5” or “Storage Level 10,” players buy actual parts and install them into their rigs.

Players can buy and use:

- Mining rig frames
- Miner cores
- GPUs
- ASIC chips
- RAM sticks
- Storage drives
- Power supplies
- Cooling units
- Network cards
- Security modules
- Utility modules
- Server rental contracts

This makes progression feel more like building a real setup inside Minecraft.

---

## Mining Rig Gameplay

Players can build and manage mining rigs using installed parts.

A mining setup can include:

- Rig frame
- Miner core
- GPU / ASIC hardware
- RAM
- Storage
- Power supply
- Cooling
- Network hardware
- Security hardware
- Utility modules

Each part can affect the rig in different ways, such as:

- Mining power
- Stability
- Storage capacity
- Power usage
- Heat
- Security
- Risk
- Efficiency

Better parts can improve output, but stronger setups may also require better cooling, power, and maintenance.

---

## Company Tech Releases

Stock Vein includes a company technology release system.

Companies slowly release new technology over time. This means servers do not have to unlock every powerful item instantly.

Tech releases are designed to be slow and progression-based:

- Companies release one item at a time
- Stronger tech appears later
- Server progression feels alive
- Admins can force or test releases
- Players get a reason to check the shop over time

This helps prevent the economy from becoming too fast or too overpowered on day one.

---

## Shop GUI

The shop is organized into clean categories so players can easily find what they need.

Shop categories include:

- Mining Rigs
- Miner Cores
- GPUs / ASICs
- RAM
- Storage
- Power
- Cooling
- Network
- Security
- Rented Servers
- Utility Tools
- Special hidden categories when active

The shop supports large item pools and paginated categories so the many technology items stay organized.

---

## Rented Servers

Players can also rent servers as part of their mining setup.

Rented servers can provide additional fictional compute power, but they may have recurring costs or limits depending on configuration.

This gives players another way to expand without only relying on physical rigs.

---

## Fake Black Market System

Stock Vein includes a rare fictional “unknown vendor” style system.

At certain times, a hidden vendor may appear and offer unusual items. These items are mysterious, risky, and powerful, but they are still completely fictional Minecraft gameplay items.

Black market content may include fake items such as:

- Signal Scramblers
- Ghost Routers
- Trace Breakers
- Corrupt Firmware Chips
- Shadow Cooling Units
- Static Relays

These items are not real hacking tools and do not teach or perform real hacking.

---

## Fake Hacking Gameplay

Stock Vein includes optional fictional high-risk hacking-style gameplay.

This is only an in-game mechanic. It does not interact with real systems, real accounts, real cryptocurrency, or real networks.

Fake hacking is designed to be:

- Expensive
- Risky
- High-compute
- High-reward
- Balanced for late-game players

By default, fake hacking requires much more fictional compute power than normal fake Bitcoin mining, making it a risky endgame mechanic instead of easy money.

---

## Anti-Exploit and Economy Safety

Stock Vein includes safer economy handling to help protect servers.

Safety features include:

- Money is withdrawn before items are given
- Failed economy transactions do not grant items
- Admin-only commands are protected by permissions
- Expensive purchases can require confirmation
- Stock Vein items are signed to reduce forged item abuse
- Admin give commands have safety caps
- Audit tools help staff review player data
- Purchase logic is designed to reduce spam-click abuse

No economy plugin is perfect, so server owners should still test their setup before launching publicly.

---

## Player Commands

Main player commands:

/stocks guide
/stocks shop
/stocks setup
/stocks stats
